title: Tech Note: The HashTools Component
author: David Adams
featured_technology: Hashing text, BLOBs, pictures, and documents

historical_commentary.text: This note documents the public/protected API of the HashTools component, a reusable 4D component (a packaged, distributable collection of 4D methods) that wraps nine hashing algorithms for text, BLOBs, pictures, and documents, plus a hash-optimized record-finding routine. 4D's component architecture for packaging reusable code is itself a durable, still-supported mechanism, and the general pattern of gateway/protected methods for parameter validation remains good practice, but this specific classic-language component is a bespoke sample never adopted as a standard 4D feature, so its practical relevance today is mainly historical/illustrative rather than as a component developers would still install.
related_updates: 4D's component/plug-in packaging mechanisms have continued to evolve (including later support for 4D language classes as lighter-weight reusable code units)
Built-in hashing and checksum needs today are more commonly met via 4D's native cryptography/hash commands or external libraries rather than a bespoke classic-language component
